products.name: Security Optimization Assessment — Defender for Identity — Commercial
products.short_description: Know exactly how well Defender for Identity is configured — a read-only Security Optimization Assessment that scores your posture and prioritizes the gaps.
products.description:
Know exactly how well Defender for Identity is configured — a read-only Security Optimization Assessment that scores your posture and prioritizes the gaps.

A deployed product is not an optimized one. This assessment reviews your Defender for Identity configuration against best practice, scores coverage and hygiene, and delivers a prioritized, risk-ranked findings report: sensor coverage on DCs/AD FS; directory-service account; honeytoken & ISPM posture; detection tuning. Read-only — it changes nothing, it tells you what to fix.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • sensor coverage on DCs/AD FS
  • directory-service account
  • honeytoken & ISPM posture
  • detection tuning
  • Prioritized, risk-ranked findings report

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A clear, scored picture of your Defender for Identity posture and a prioritized remediation backlog — the evidence to fix what matters, in order.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • SOAMDI-Assess.ps1 — read-only scoring of Defender for Identity posture against a named best-practice baseline
    • SOAMDI-Coverage.ps1 — read-only sensor-coverage reconciliation for Defender for Identity (the centerpiece check)
    • SOAMDI-Discovery.ps1 — read-only collection of the AD identity inventory and Defender for Identity configuration signals into a dated run folder
    • SOAMDI-Report.ps1 — read-only generation of the prioritized, risk-ranked Defender for Identity findings report (HTML + CSV)
    • SOAMDI-Validate.ps1 — self-check that the assessor can READ the AD inventory + MDI signals and has NO write access

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
